note: [L] carries the interval bound in Work.G09.answer (statement Bid.G09) and the field bound quota <= 2e in ManyCopies.joins. Difference: the discount appears as gainChart = exp((s_m - s_l)/8) multiplying the left side, and E_m is a parameter w or e bounded below by 4(1+C_m) times the combined cost.

theorem answer : YM.Bid.G09 := by
  intro G W H hC hbank N p d k o F B A P w _ hP i hi hi'
  obtain ⟨hh,hr⟩ := cone_cost hC hbank hP i hi hi'
  have hs : F.coeffSize (P.voice i).x ≤ P.cost i := by
    have hx := (H.levels.params i).columns_ge
    apply le_trans _ hh
    exact le_mul_of_one_le_left (coeff_nonneg F _) (by nlinarith only [hx])
  rw [mul_add]
  have hgam := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs (show 0 ≤ gainChart H o i from (Real.exp_pos _).le)
  linarith only [hgam, hr, cost_finest hC hbank hP]

proof_context.conclusion: Proves Bid.G09: for k <= i <= o, gainChart(o,i)(cost_i + mu(x_i)) <= 4(1+C_o)w, where gainChart = exp((s_o - s_i)/8), i.e. the factor (a_o/a_i)^{1/8}.
